title: RainbowPlus: Enhancing Adversarial Prompt Generation via Evolutionary Quality-Diversity Search

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the 'Violence and Hate' and 'Inciting or Abetting Discrimination' risk categories, as well as the DangerousQA dataset (which includes racism), by generating adversarial prompts via evolutionary quality-diversity search and measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) with an LLM judge.

Evaluated under the broader safety framework's 'Violence and Hate' and 'Inciting or Abetting Discrimination' risk categories by generating adversarial prompts targeting protected attributes and measuring the model's compliance (ASR).
